name: sss
description: Personal skill bundle. jira-ticket: write and create Story / Task / Bug / Sub-task tickets in the hyrd Jira, project MAMAS. release-readiness: read-only report on what is going into the next release — commits since the last release, the tickets they bundle, statuses, blockers, and a suggested next version. autoship, delegate-tickets and setup-cursor-worker drive autonomous and parallel implementation via Orca workers; they require the matt plugin and an Orca install.
